title: Bandit Toll
description: Three rough figures emerge from behind rusted sawmill machinery, blocking your path. Their leader, a scarred woman with a notched axe, spits at your feet. 'Toll's ten gold. Pay up or we take it from your corpse.'

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.description: Hand over 10 gold. At least you spot some wood scraps nearby.

outcomes.text: The bandit counts the coins and nods. 'Smart choice.' They melt back into the machinery. You grab a wood bundle they missed.
'Pleasure doing business.' The leader tosses you a dented flask. 'For the road. No hard feelings, yeah?'
You pay, but as you pass, one of them trips you and rifles through your pack. They take a bit extra.

choices.label: Stand your ground
choices.description: Show them you won't be easy prey.

outcomes.text: Your party draws weapons. The bandits exchange nervous glances and scatter, dropping a few coins in their haste.
The leader snarls and lunges! A vicious brawl erupts. You drive them off, but not without bruises.
They charge in! The fight is desperate and bloody. Your party barely holds the line.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.description: They look slow. Maybe you can outrun them.

outcomes.text: You bolt before they can react! Their curses fade behind you as the forest swallows the path.
You almost make it clean, but a thrown axe clips one of your heroes. You keep running.
One of them is faster than they look! They tackle your rearguard and strip a piece of equipment before you drive them off.
